info.title: WarmHawk API
info.description: The real, current shape of warmhawk-core-engine's /v1 API and its one unauthenticated /public endpoint, transcribed field-by-field from https://warmhawk.com/docs/api-reference/*. WarmHawk is self-hosted per customer — there is no single production host, so every server URL below is a placeholder for whatever domain a customer's own install.sh run bound (e.g. api.yourcompany.com). Outbound webhooks (WarmHawk calling a customer's own URL when something happens) are planned, not implemented — poll GET /v1/replies, GET /v1/queue/status, or GET /v1/domains/{id}/placement-sample instead.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <token> obtained from POST /v1/auth/login. Required on every route except POST /v1/auth/login itself, the two /v1/oauth/* routes, and POST /v1/leads/webhook.

post.summary: Log in and receive a bearer token
post.description: Authenticates against the engine's own User table — separate from the Tier 1/2 dashboard's own login. Rate-limited (10/min) and brute-force locked out per account, both layers active at once.

401.description: Invalid credentials — constant response shape whether the account exists or not, to avoid user enumeration.

429.description: Account locked from repeated failures. Body includes retryAfterMs.

delete.description: Anonymizes PII across every campaign, preserves aggregate counts.

patch.summary: Edit a lead before it's emailed
patch.description: Fix an address, a name or a merge field in place. Only an UNTOUCHED lead changes; the lead keeps its place in the send order.

409.description: The address is on the blocked list, already a lead on this campaign, or the lead has already been emailed

post.description: Blocking an address also stops any lead that has it.

get.description: Each row includes mailboxIds, steps, senders (each ticked mailbox, its status and whether its domain has a mailing address), launch { canLaunch, problems }, progress, leadsCount, sentCount, repliesCount, domainsCount and lastActivityAt. Each campaign also carries sendWindow, nextSendAt, aiWrittenCount, aiFallbackCount and progress.followUpsSent / progress.upcomingFollowUps. A campaign with nothing left to send moves to COMPLETED on its own, and back to ACTIVE when it gets new work.

post.description: Returns the created row plus a computed contentQuality score.

aiPromptTemplate.description: Mustache-placeholder AI instructions, e.g. "Write a 2-sentence opener to {{firstName}} at {{company}}."

aiProvider.description: BYOK — your own Gemini or Claude API key.

aiMode.description: PERSONALIZE (AI Adjusts): the AI adds to your own email. PROMPT (AI Writes): the AI writes the email from your instructions and offer.

aiWritesSubject.description: Let the AI write the subject line too.

unsubscribeUrlTemplate.description: Optional. Your own unsubscribe page; {{email}} is replaced with the recipient's address. Left out, every email links to the built-in unsubscribe page on the install's domain.

mailboxIds.description: Optional on create. Mailbox ids this campaign sends first emails from. Replaces the whole set. Only these mailboxes are used; new mailboxes are never added on their own.

steps.description: Follow-ups, in order. Replaces the whole list. Each goes from the lead's pinned mailbox as a reply in the same thread, and a reply, bounce, unsubscribe or suppression stops the sequence.

body.description: Sent as-is when AI is off or fails. May be empty in a draft; launch refuses an empty one.

aiRewrite.description: Rewrite this step with the campaign's AI provider.

sendTimezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/Chicago. null (the default) means no schedule: send any time.

sendDays.description: Sending days, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday. Non-empty, no repeats.

sendStartMinute.description: Start of the sending window, in minutes after midnight.

sendEndMinute.description: End of the sending window, in minutes after midnight. Must be after sendStartMinute.

useLeadTimezone.description: Send in each lead's own time zone, read from a Time zone, Country, State or City column; falls back to sendTimezone.

maxNewLeadsPerDay.description: Cap on first emails per day for this campaign; follow-ups are not counted.

422.description: A field is invalid, e.g. a bad schedule; { error } says which in a plain sentence.

post.summary: Preview one email as a lead gets it
post.description: Renders the first email or a follow-up exactly as the send path would, footer included. Draft fields in the body are layered over the saved campaign, so unsaved edits preview too. With AI on, this makes one call on your own key. Nothing is stored.

leadIndex.description: One of the campaign's first three leads; a sample lead before any are imported.

leadId.description: One of the campaign's own leads, instead of leadIndex. Needs campaignId. The preview goes from the mailbox that lead is assigned to, and a follow-up keeps the subject the lead's thread really has.

skipAi.description: Render the campaign's own text even when AI would write this email; no provider call.

200.description: The rendered email: subject, body, sender, lead, complianceMissing, and usesAi (whether AI writes this email at send time)

patch.description: Only fields present change. Recomputes contentQuality when template or subject changes. status and unknown fields are refused with 422: a campaign goes live only through POST /campaigns/{id}/launch. Schedule fields merge with the saved ones; sendTimezone: null clears the schedule.

get.summary: Run the launch check without launching

problems.description: Each blocks launch. DOMAIN_NO_ADDRESS carries domainId, domainName and mailboxCount; STEP_EMPTY carries position; FIELD_UNKNOWN carries field (a {{field}} no lead has); FIELD_BLANK carries field and missingCount (leads that leave a fallback-less field blank).

200.description: status set to ACTIVE; the campaign plus warnings[]

422.description: Can't launch yet: { error, problems, warnings }. Problems: NO_SENDERS (no mailbox picked, or all paused), DOMAIN_NO_ADDRESS (one per sending domain without a mailing address), NO_UNSUBSCRIBE (no unsubscribeUrlTemplate on an install with no domain for the built-in page), BOUNCE_PAUSED, EMAIL_EMPTY, STEP_EMPTY, FIELD_UNKNOWN, FIELD_BLANK.

problems.description: Each blocks launch. DOMAIN_NO_ADDRESS carries domainId, domainName and mailboxCount; STEP_EMPTY carries position; FIELD_UNKNOWN carries field (a {{field}} no lead has); FIELD_BLANK carries field and missingCount (leads that leave a fallback-less field blank).

post.description: Runs the launch check and sets status ACTIVE. Every problem comes back at once; warnings never block and are returned on success too.
One [Test] email as lead leadIndex would get it, from the first ticked mailbox. No lead changes, nothing is logged, and its unsubscribe link blocks nobody.

post.summary: Duplicate a campaign as a draft

sentByDay.description: Sends per UTC day for the last 6 days and today, oldest first.

queuedByDay.description: Every pending dispatch job (not only the 50 in jobs) counted by the UTC day it is due; overdue jobs count toward today. Soonest day first, only days with jobs.

mailboxes.description: Per mailbox: its campaigns, and for the 2 UTC days either side of today its sent, warm-up, queued and cap counts. Warm-up sends don't count toward cap.

get.description: Every pending send, soonest first, up to 50, with the full match count in total.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DD; only sends due that day. Overdue ones count toward today.

step.description: What this job sends: 0 = the first email, N = follow-up N.

dkimSelector.description: DKIM selector this domain signs with (the part before ._domainkey). Only needed when your provider mints a per-customer selector (Amazon SES, Postmark, ZeptoMail). 422 if not a valid DNS label.

mailingAddress.description: The CAN-SPAM postal address printed in the footer of every campaign email sent from this domain, one line per footer line. Blank or null clears it. There is no install-wide fallback.

mailingAddressParts.description: The address as fields; when given, mailingAddress is built from it. Needs street, city and country.

Referenced in the Queue/domains/webhooks reference as the polling substitute for a not-yet-built outbound webhook system. Field-level response shape isn't published in the prose docs yet — see the Replies & team guide for behavior.

get.summary: Free, unauthenticated SPF/DKIM/DMARC + List-Unsubscribe + blocklist check
get.description: The exact endpoint behind https://warmhawk.com/tools/domain-check. Response shape verified against warmhawk-site's own client (components/DomainCheckTool.tsx), which types this contract directly against apps/api/src/routes/publicDomainCheck.ts. spf/dkim/dmarc are bare 'PASS'|'FAIL' strings with no per-check detail — dnsChecks.ts's checkSpf/checkDkim/checkDmarc don't produce one. listUnsubscribeCheck is a plain explanatory string, not a checkable status, because RFC 8058 headers live on a sent message, not something resolvable from DNS for a bare domain.

listUnsubscribeCheck.description: Plain-language explanation, not a PASS/FAIL status.
